name: Gloriana Lemieux
description: Gloriana Lemieux is a human commoner who runs her own competing branch of Salon Lemieux across from Trollskull Manor. Known for her glowing skin and vibrant red beehive laced with pearls that stands at least a foot high, she offers top-tier beauty and skin treatments.
ideals: Perfection: Delivering the absolute latest trends in skin care and hair design to high-society patrons.
Supremacy: Proving her salon is superior to her sister's in every measurable way.
bonds: Salon Lemieux (W2) and her devoted fashion-forward clientele.
Her intense, long-standing rivalry with her twin sister, Floriana.
flaws: Prone to explosive shouting matches with her sister that disrupt the peace of the alley at all hours.
speech_patterns: Loud, theatrical, and expressive, often punctuating her conversations with dramatic gestures about style or complaints about her sibling.
mannerisms: Tosses her pearl-laced red beehive hair, inspects clients' nails with meticulous care, and participates in daily verbal shouting matches across the street.

relationships.name: Floriana Lemieux
relationships.relationship: Twin Sister / Business Competitor / Bitter Rival

motivations: To maintain her status as a premier beauty expert in the North Ward and win the ongoing feud against her sister.
knowledge: Expertise in cosmetics, dermatology, local fashion trends, and gossip regarding the elite patrons of the North Ward.
gm_notes: Gloriana Lemieux provides vibrant neighborhood color and localized conflict right outside Trollskull Manor. She can pull the party into quirky side quests involving mediation between the twins, accidental discovery of political plots overheard in her chair, or crises involving toxic cosmetic suppliers.
